in_marathi.name: Dipesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dipesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dipesh is derived from Sanskrit, where 'di' means 'two' and 'pada' means 'feet'. It is a reverential term used to signify respect for the divine. In Hindu mythology, the gods are often referred to as 'padapadme' or 'the one with divine feet'.
